summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Gene Ball, a computer scientist. It covers his education, including a bachelor's degree from the University of Oklahoma and graduate study at the University of Rochester, where he earned a master's and doctorate by 1982. It also notes that at Rochester he met Rick Rashid and they co-created Alto Trek, an early networked multiplayer computer game.
one_line: Gene Ball is a computer scientist whose education at Rochester led to co-creating Alto Trek, an early networked multiplayer game, with Rick Rashid.
key_facts: Gene Ball obtained a bachelor's degree from the University of Oklahoma.
Gene Ball attended graduate school at the University of Rochester.
Gene Ball completed a master's degree at the University of Rochester.
Gene Ball finished his doctorate in 1982.
While at Rochester, Gene Ball met Rick Rashid.
Gene Ball and Rick Rashid together created Alto Trek.
Alto Trek is described as one of the earlier networked multiplayer computer games.
